0e9a16c9769d3d6aa2323363b290923f9c7b4464.sourceText: 新点进入缓存时，`intensity` 暂存“该帧时间戳减首次点云时间戳”，用于历史管理；输出时再改为高度差。容器 PCL 的体素滤波默认平均各字段，因此年龄判定针对重采样代表点，不能理解为逐个原始点精确保留时间。
0e9a16c9769d3d6aa2323363b290923f9c7b4464.translatedText: When a new point enters the cache,`intensity`temporarily store "the frame timestamp minus the timestamp of the first point cloud" for history management; when outputting, change it to height difference\. The voxel filter of the container PCL averages each field by default, so the age determination targets the resampled representative point and cannot be understood as accurately preserving time for each original point\.
